instruction: I'd prefer not to have the message preview pane visible at all. Can you disable the message pane in Thunderbird so only the message list is shown?

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the message preview pane in Thunderbird. The evaluator checks if mail.pane_config.dynamic preference is set to 2 (no message pane). Standard Thunderbird preference: 0=vertical, 1=wide, 2=disabled. Similar complexity to original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly targets the right preference: mail.pane_config.dynamic=2 is the standard Thunderbird setting for disabling the message preview pane
Postconfig properly closes Thunderbird window to ensure prefs.js is written with updated settings before verification
Getter extracts the correct state file: /home/user/.thunderbird/t5q2a5hp.default-release/prefs.js where Thunderbird stores preferences
Metric check_thunderbird_prefs correctly parses prefs.js format and matches the preference key-value pair using exact comparison (eq method)
Complete coverage: instruction has single requirement (disable message pane) and evaluator checks exactly that requirement
Data flow is semantically correct: prefs.js -> parse preferences -> check mail.pane_config.dynamic=2
Edge case handling: metric returns 0.0 if file is None or preference not found
